title: Save Toolkit runbook frontmatter v1
description: The machine-linkable YAML frontmatter every runbook carries (skills/runbook/assets/runbook-template.md), expressed as the equivalent JSON object. Alert-to-runbook links, KB indexes, and staleness watches key on these fields. Dates are ISO 8601; last_reviewed changes only through human/authorized document review, last_verified only through bound rehearsal evidence, and a validator or reader must never upgrade either.

runbook_id.description: Stable kebab-case slug; renaming a runbook is a new id plus an explicit redirect note, never a silent reuse.

service_id.description: Stable slug of the service card this runbook belongs to.

alert_names.description: Exact alert names that route here. Empty is legal only for task/SOP-shaped runbooks with no paging trigger.

source_revision.description: repository@full-sha or reviewed release identifier the procedures were written against.

last_reviewed.description: Null until a human/authorized document review sets it.

last_verified.description: Null until rehearsal evidence binds this exact runbook version, target, actor, timestamp, and outcome.

verification_evidence.description: Links or evidence ids for each rehearsal that set last_verified; never prose claims.
